description: This source file defines the 'XGraphicsPath' class, which provides a versatile abstraction for creating and manipulating vector paths used in PDF rendering across multiple platforms (GDI, WPF, UWP). It includes methods for adding various geometric shapes, lines, curves, arcs, and text to the path, with platform-specific implementations. The class supports cloning, combining paths, and platform-specific path construction, serving as the core component for complex drawing operations within the PDFsharp library.

classes.name: XGraphicsPath
classes.description: Represents a series of connected lines and curves, supporting platform-specific implementations for drawing vector graphics in PDFs.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the current path instance, including platform-specific path data.

methods.name: AddLine
methods.description: Adds a line segment to the current figure, with platform-specific overloads for different point types.

methods.name: AddLines
methods.description: Adds multiple connected line segments from an array of points.

methods.name: AddBezier
methods.description: Adds a cubic Bézier curve to the current figure with specified control points.

methods.name: AddBeziers
methods.description: Adds multiple connected Bézier curves from an array of control points.

methods.name: AddCurve
methods.description: Adds a spline curve based on given points, supporting tension parameter.

methods.name: AddArc
methods.description: Adds an arc segment defined by rectangle and angles, with platform-specific implementations.

methods.name: AddRectangle
methods.description: Adds a rectangle to the path, with overloads for different rectangle types.

methods.name: AddRoundedRectangle
methods.description: Adds a rectangle with rounded corners, platform-dependent implementation.

methods.name: AddEllipse
methods.description: Adds an ellipse or circle to the path.

methods.name: AddPolygon
methods.description: Adds a polygon shape from a series of points.

methods.name: AddPie
methods.description: Adds a pie shape outline to the path.

methods.name: AddClosedCurve
methods.description: Adds a closed spline curve connecting given points, with optional tension.

methods.name: AddPath
methods.description: Appends another path to this one, optionally connecting them.

methods.name: AddString
methods.description: Adds text as a path, platform-specific methods handle different string layout types and font handling.

classes.name: XGraphicsPath
classes.description: Represents a series of connected lines and curves with platform-specific implementations for drawing vector graphics in PDFs.

methods.name: CloseFigure
methods.description: Closes the current figure, ending the current subpath.

methods.name: StartFigure
methods.description: Starts a new figure/subpath without closing the previous one.

methods.name: Widen
methods.description: Expands the path outline based on a specified pen, optionally transforming with a matrix and adjusting flatness.

methods.name: Flatten
methods.description: Converts curves into line segments, with optional path transformation and flatness adjustments.

methods.name: Internals
methods.description: Provides access to internal representations of the path, such as CoreGraphicsPath, GDI+ Path, or WPF PathGeometry.

properties.name: FillMode
properties.description: Gets or sets the fill mode used to determine how the interior of the shapes is filled.

methods.name: DrawString
methods.description: Draws a string into the path, with platform-specific implementations for GDI and WPF, including positioning and formatting logic. Throws if font family is not resolvable.
